title: Taking the first USO unit, Rhythm and the Blues, overseas
summary: Dick Campbell sent her with the first Black USO unit to China, Burma and India, and later on European and American tours; Snub Mosley came later, and she was the only woman.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Yes, that's right. I was right here in New York, but I was getting ready to go back to Europe. So in the meantime Dick Campbell called me and asked me to take the first USO show.

Dick Campbell was the one -- a colored fellow, but he was getting most of the artists together for the USO shows. So they sent me -- I took the first unit called Rhythm and the Blues -- overseas -- China, Burma and India, first unit.
Oh, gosh, we were gone so long. I don't remember how long. And after we finished that, we came right back.

No, this was before Snub Moseley, because I took -- I went -- then I came back, and then the European tour for USO, and after the European tour, then I think is when Snub Moseley came in.
Oh, that was -- that was during the Korean War or something.

That's right. That's right. But I took all my show -- and then I came and toured America with the USO shows, because I remember having played out here at Reickers Island and all with USO shows. And then came Snub Moseley.
And I was the only woman, you know, because they said they didn't have no place for no crybabies, so they sent me, because they said I had a lot of nerve.
